name: Mepirapim
summary: MEPIRAPIM is an indole-based cannabinoid which differs from JWH-018 by having a 4-methylpiperazine group in place of the naphthyl group and has been used as an active ingredient in synthetic cannabis products. It was first identified in Japan in 2013, alongside FUBIMINA. MEPIRAPIM acts as a T-type calcium channel inhibitor and is only minimally active at the CB1 receptor.

pharmacology.text: MEPIRAPIM acts as a T-type calcium channel inhibitor and is only minimally active at the CB1 receptor.

uses.text: MEPIRAPIM is an indole-based cannabinoid which differs from JWH-018 by having a 4-methylpiperazine group in place of the naphthyl group and has been used as an active ingredient in synthetic cannabis products.

summaryZh: MEPIRAPIM，化學名(4-甲基哌嗪-1-基)(1-戊基吲哚-3-基)甲酮（英語：methanone），分子式C19H27N3O，是JWH-018的結構類似物，其中4-甲基哌嗪基團替代了萘基團，能作為大麻素，2013年在日本首次發現，一同檢出的還有FUBIMINA。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about its effects in people. It has been sold in synthetic cannabis products, which can cause a racing heart, agitation, psychosis and seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它曾出現在合成大麻產品中，而這類產品可能引起心跳過快、躁動、精神病與癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它曾出现在合成大麻产品中，而这类产品可能引起心跳过快、躁动、精神病与癫痫发作。

fact.en: Although it was sold in synthetic cannabis products, mepirapim barely activates cannabinoid receptors and instead blocks T-type calcium channels.
fact.zh: 雖然它曾被加入合成大麻產品中販售，但 mepirapim 幾乎不會活化大麻素受體，反而會阻斷 T 型鈣離子通道。
fact.zhHans: 虽然它曾被加入合成大麻产品中贩售，但 mepirapim 几乎不会活化大麻素受体，反而会阻断 T 型钙离子信道。
